positive_cases.name: setuid_bit_set
positive_cases.scenario: Setuid bit applied to a binary in a temporary directory.
positive_cases.rationale: Tool and mode selections both match.

positive_cases.name: world_writable_mode
positive_cases.scenario: World-writable mode applied to a shared directory.
positive_cases.rationale: Tool and mode selections both match.

negative_cases.name: restrictive_mode
negative_cases.scenario: Restrictive mode applied to a key file.
negative_cases.rationale: The mode selection does not match.

negative_cases.name: ownership_change
negative_cases.scenario: Ownership changed on an application directory.
negative_cases.rationale: The tool selection does not match.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
